messages:
eli: Heads up — cert-manager started failing uploads to keystore in sa-east-1 after the RBAC prune. Proxies show mTLS handshakes dropping with "keystore: principal mismatch". Anyone on keystore roles?

 tasha: seeing ~1% unwrap_denied on ingress in sa-east. sample req id c3a9. keystore logs show KMS AccessDenied for alias/ingress-key-sa-east.

 sre-bot: alert KEYSERVICE.UNWRAP_DENIED 2026-05-10T04:12:00Z region=sa-east rate=1.2%

 cloudinfra: quick scan: key policy for alias/ingress-key-sa-east still lists explicit ARN arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-legacy. RBAC job renamed principals to arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-sa-role. Looks like the key-policy update step did not apply to this alias (error suppressed).

 eli: proposed plan:
 - (P0) add tag-based principal rule to the key policy to allow principals with tag "service:keystore" (cloudinfra) — ETA 20m
 - (P0) run canary decrypt and trigger cert refresh for impacted nodes (tasha) — ETA 30m
 - (P1) fix policy-updater to validate principal ARNs after RBAC rename and fail fast (eli) — ETA PR

 tasha: applying patch now. snippet of intended policy statement:
 ```
 Statement: Allow
 Principal: "*"
 Condition: StringEquals {"aws:PrincipalTag/service":"keystore"}
 Action: "kms:Decrypt"
 ```

 cloudinfra: patch applied to alias/ingress-key-sa-east; propagation ~45s

 tasha: canary result: req=canary-kt-01 status=200 decrypt_ms=36; unwrap_denied rate down to baseline

 eli: leaving old role ARN in the key policy for 48h as a safety window. Follow-ups: add RBAC preflight diff that verifies KMS key policies, add test coverage for tag-based principal propagation, and add an alert for missing principal fields in CloudTrail. Filing incident INC-2026-0510 and assigning postmortem to eli.
